title: Content-first authoring
summary: One public route in one locale is authored in exactly one content/<locale>/<route>.md; public prose has no parallel owner.
invariants: One locale route has exactly one content/<locale>/<route>.md owner.
A page does not require a sibling page JSON unless it overrides composition.
Shared public UI strings are loaded only from content/<locale>/lang.json.
Page prose is not loaded from resources/i18n, site.json or component manifests.
Package-owned CLI messages never enter public PageBuilder inputs.
